plugins.description: Quota awareness + night-scheduler integration. A UserPromptSubmit hook nudges when the session window is filling; a skill lets Claude defer heavy work to the night executor via the local `llm-squeeze` CLI. Requires the `llm-squeeze` CLI/daemon (run `bash scripts/setup.sh` once).
